summary.en: The line to visit the Robanov Emperor Exhibition today is very long because Kaito Kid will appear tonight to target the Queen’s Bang, the crown with the world’s largest ruby ​​and also the centerpiece of the exhibition. Conan is present following Jirokichi's invitation along with Ran and Sonoko. Amuro and Azusa join in with them by chance because the Café Poirot owner has allowed them to visit the exhibition while the air conditioner (AC for short) of the café is under maintenance. Azusa suggests that the girls should go into a group while the boys do the same so that Amuro's fans can have a more favorable view. Advanced Notice:"Tonight at midnight, while you're lost in pale daydreams, I shall snatch the Queen's Bang" Tiara embedded with one of the world's largest garnets and part of the Romanov treasure. The five still have to wait for their turn to visit the exhibition like everyone else, so Amuro is asked by his friends to make some interesting tricks with the cards Sonoko brought along. Suddenly, Amuro’s card tricks are deemed to be child plays by a mysterious person, whom Conan reveals to be Kaitou Kid in disguise to provoke the boy. However, the provocation ends up exciting Amuro as he calls Kazami, who is attending an idol festival featuring Yoko Okino, to join him.
summary.zhHans: 怪盗基德相关作品以预告、变装、宝石目标和柯南的追踪对决为核心，属于独立角色专题线。
